CardMaker recreation of the '''original''' 7 side (Gather Allies And Train) of [[The Hidden Path / Gather Allies And Train]] (Virtual Set 26, 8 December 2025).

Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text. No copy of the first Virtual Set 26 release sheet or of the first card images was archived; the re-issued sheet of 26 December 2025 and today's PC card images show later texts ([[The Hidden Path / Gather Allies And Train (Errata)]], [[The Hidden Path / Gather Allies And Train (Errata 2)]]).

Text source: the Players Committee's card data, Set 26 entry of 6 December 2025 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/d30e95d3 swccg-card-json d30e95d3]), kept by the PC as pre-errata card 40099 in [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/main/LightPreErrata.json LightPreErrata.json]. Text: “Gather Allies And Train: While this side up, if your holocron is about to leave table, place it in Used Pile. Your lightsaber Force drain bonuses may not be canceled. Opponent's total battle destiny where they have a character of ability > 4 is -1. During your move phase, may relocate a Jedi between a Jabiim site and a battleground site as a regular move for free. At the end of your turn, opponent loses 1 Force. Flip this card if Jedi do not occupy two sites.”

Made: 12 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (swccg.com/cardmaker), from the PC card image of the current printing (frame, art, title, destiny, margin name); no errata mark. The PC image of this side also prints the art credit “Image courtesy of mjb_customs @ Instagram” along the left edge; the recreation leaves it out. Not an official image.
